name: io.github.KIvanow/spend-brake
title: Spend Brake capped search
description: Web search for agents with hard dollar caps: Tavily and Exa through a budget-enforcing proxy.

environmentVariables.name: BRAKE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Spend Brake virtual key (sb_live_…); its caps apply to every search

environmentVariables.name: BRAKE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Spend Brake proxy, e.g. https://proxy.spendbrake.dev

environmentVariables.name: BRAKE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Spend Brake admin API, for the budget tool, e.g. https://app.spendbrake.dev
